meaning_en: Default brush-off. Usually automatic, not a real decision.
coaching_en: Don't argue. Acknowledge, then leave a hook. 'Can I just leave you info in case your price goes up?'
responses_es: Lo entiendo. ¿Le puedo dejar la información por si acaso? No le cuesta nada.
Está bien, no hay problema. Solo le pregunto — ¿cuánto paga ahorita de internet?

meaning_en: They're genuinely busy or using it as an excuse.
coaching_en: Respect their time. Ask for a better time to come back.
responses_es: Disculpe la molestia. ¿Cuándo sería un mejor momento para pasar? Solo toma unos minutos.

meaning_en: Hard stop. Customer is firm or getting agitated.
coaching_en: ⛔ STOP. Do NOT push. Thank them and leave immediately. Burning this bridge hurts the whole team.
responses_es: Disculpe la molestia. Que tenga un excelente día.
